title: 3D Fit Trainee
description: Because you can see how we can be better. Innovate, your way. Quality at Primark What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way. **What You’ll Get** : People are at the heart of what we do here, so it’s essential we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. Let’s talk lifestyle: * 27 days of leave, pension. * Because Primark is all about tailoring to you, we offer Tax Saver Tickets, fitness centre and a subsidised cafeteria. **What You’ll Do as a** **3D Fit Trainee** We want you to feel challenged and inspired. Here, you’ll develop your skills across a range of responsibilities: * Support the maintenance and governance of the Global Block Library and related digital tools, ensuring fit blocks, grading standards, and seasonal information are accurate, up to date, and accessible to internal stakeholders and suppliers. * Assist with the rollout and application of Fit Expression, Length Guides, fit standards, and grading rules to help deliver a consistent customer fit experience across Womenswear, Menswear, and Childrenswear. * Develop technical knowledge of apparel grading, sizing, and fit principles, supporting accurate product fit, size progression, and adherence to best-practice standards. * Collaborate with Buying, Design, QA teams, and the global supply base to support the adoption of digital fitting technologies and emerging product development processes. * Support fit-focused projects through the maintenance of technical documentation, digital assets, training materials, and guidance resources, helping to build capability across stakeholders and suppliers. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analysing fit-related feedback, supporting KPI reporting, and leveraging digital tools to improve efficiency, consistency, and product development outcomes. **What You’ll Bring** Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular: * Relevant qualification in Pattern Cutting, Garment Technology, Fashion Design, or a related discipline, with 1–2 years' experience or a graduate background in apparel product development. * Strong interest in garment fit, sizing, product development, and pattern technology, with a desire to build technical expertise across apparel categories. * Understanding of, or willingness to learn, digital product development tools such as CLO 3D, Browzwear, or similar 3D design platforms. * Basic knowledge of garment construction, manufacturing processes, and apparel grading principles, with an eagerness to develop expertise in fit and size progression. * Awareness of fabric properties and performance characteristics, with an understanding of their impact on garment fit, construction, quality, and overall product performance. Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours. **About Primark** At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to a £9bn+ turnover business and over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 20 countries today. Our values run through everything we do. In essence, we're Caring and always strive to put people first. We're also Dynamic, bravely pushing the boundaries to stay ahead. And finally, we succeed Together. If you need any reasonable adjustments or have an accessibility request, during your recruitment journey, such as extended time or breaks between online assessments, a sign language interpreter, mobility access, or assistive technology please contact your talent acquisition specialist. All offers of employment are subject to background checks, including right to work, reference education and for some roles criminal, and financial checks. If you have any concerns, please reach out to our talent acquisition team to discuss. **REQ ID:** JR-12750

title: Account Executive - SMB Outbound
description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** Every new SMB merchant we bring on is a small business getting a better way to get paid and grow. As a Merchant Attach Hunter, you'll acquire new-logo merchants — including win back business — from partner platforms, working a mix of DBM, partner-generated and AI-self-prospected leads. It's a fast-paced, high-volume acquisition role: qualify quickly, present a clear value proposition, and hand off a well-onboarded merchant to the Account Management team. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Engage and collaborate with the immediate team. * Contribute to solutions and suggest efficiencies. * Exercise judgment on issues of importance. * Acquire, manage, and expand relationships with small and medium-sized merchants. * Prioritize work and ensure task completion guided by policies and procedures. **Minimum Qualifications:** * 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:** **What You'll Do** * Qualify partner-sourced and AI-qualified leads, prioritising outreach against defined policies and procedures. * Present standard onboarding and value propositions to merchants operating on partner platforms. * Handle routine objections, close the right opportunities, and support a smooth path to PayPal acceptance. * Keep accurate activity, pipeline and next-step records, and hand newly acquired merchants to AM1 or AM2 with complete context. **What You'll Bring — Minimum Qualifications** * 3+ years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Core Capabilities We're Looking For * Skilled at qualifying a lead quickly, asking focused questions, spotting fit, and advancing the right opportunities efficiently. * A clear, confident communicator who explains value in terms that land with the merchant and handles common objections calmly. * Disciplined about pipeline hygiene, accurate stages, next actions and follow-up cadence, even across a high-volume funnel. * A good handoff partner who works within playbooks, asks for help appropriately, and transfers complete context to Account Management. **Nice To Have — Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in sales, customer acquisition, inside sales or a comparable customer-facing environment. **Subsidiary:** PayPal **Travel Percent:** 0 PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** Click Here to learn more about our culture and community. **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Android Lifecycle Management Specialist - €40-45k (Dublin)

You’ll help keep devices secure and reliable while planning deployments around each customer’s network, software and operational needs. You’ll work with customers and colleagues from the Android Lifecycle Services team to plan updates, test them, coordinate rollouts and check that devices continue to perform as expected. **What you’ll do** * Provision and configure Android devices using approved procedures and schedules. * Prepare and deploy operating system updates to address security vulnerabilities and maintain device plan large file distributions while considering network performance. * Clear, professional communication skills and confidence working directly with customers. * A dependable, organised approach, with knowledge comparable to the concepts covered by CompTIA Security+ and networking knowledge aligned with CompTIA Network+. **Training and development** You’ll be expected to complete and maintain relevant Google Android Enterprise Academy certifications, which may include architecture and implementation, associate, professional and support certificates. Training access will be provided.

title: Associate - Debt Capital Markets & Structured Finance
description: **Practice Area:** Debt Capital Markets, Structured Finance and Derivatives team **Position:** Associate **PQE:** 0 - 4 years **Position Type:** Permanent **Firm:** Mason Hayes & Curran LLP is a leading Irish law firm based in Dublin. We also have offices in London, New York and San Francisco. We are a full-service business law firm with extensive knowledge and experience in the following sectors: Financial Services, Energy, Built Environment, Technology and Healthcare & Life Sciences. **The Role** Our Debt Capital Markets, Structured Finance & Derivatives team is hiring and is interested in hearing from Associates or Senior Associates with any level of PQE who have an interest in this area of practice. The DCM-SF team advises international clients on capital markets and structured finance transactions executed in, and through, Ireland, including repacks and other asset securitisations. We also write and advise on derivatives transactions and credit risk transfer instrument, either on a standalone basis or linked to a wider transaction. Our assistance includes the structuring, documentation and execution of these transactions. Our clients include market participants, such as issuers, sponsors and originators, arrangers and programme coordinators, asset managers, trustees and agents. We also advise a number of high-profile multilateral development banks and international financial institutions on Irish and public international law. If you are interested in joining an internationally focussed team which sits within a progressive, flexible, and modern law firm, please get in touch. **Candidate Requirements** * PQE related experience, or relevant rotation experience during traineeship if NQ. * Transactional experience in a capital markets or banking and finance department of a commercial law firm. * Experience in debt capital markets, structured finance/securitisation and/or derivatives is a plus but not essential. * Attitude is key. You must be pro-active and willing to work collaboratively within a team environment. * Strong focus on client services, responsiveness and the ability to manage multiple clients. **Responsibilities of the role include** * Working with clients to establish and document all types of debt capital markets transactions and structured finance transactions backed by a diverse range of asset types. * Drafting and reviewing offering documents (including prospectuses) for standalone issuances and programme offerings. * Managing and documenting new issuances, corporate actions and programme enhancements on existing note programmes. * Listing debt securities on Euronext Dublin, Vienna Stock Exchange and other leading stock exchanges. * Working with a range multilateral development banks to implement credit risk transfer instruments as part of their financing operations. * Negotiating master agreements and credit support arrangements for a range of derivative transactions. * Advising on related regulatory instruments, including the Prospectus Regulation, Securitisation Regulation, EMIR, MAR, SFTR etc. **Why MHC?** * Excellent remuneration and benefits package; pension, healthcare & bonus. * Enviable client base and strong career progression opportunities. * Flexible/hybrid working arrangements. * Friendly, open and informal working atmosphere. * Focus on employee involvement, wellbeing and success. * Social events, clubs and initiatives (Green Team, Working on Wellness, subsidised fitness classes, MHC RISE, Diversity, Sports & Social and Art Committee). * MHC knowledge and education programme to facilitate major development as a lawyer. Find out more about a career at Mason Hayes & Curran here: https://www.mhc.ie/careers

title: Associate - ISIF Investments
description: **Job Title: Associate - ISIF Investments** **Division/Function: Ireland Strategic Investment Fund** **Contract Type: 23 Month FTC** **Commencement Date: September 2027** * Closing Date for Applications: 9th October 2026 \*\*\*\* **Summary of the Business:** The National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) provides asset and liability management services to the Irish Government. It has evolved from a single function agency managing the National Debt to a manager of a complex portfolio of public assets and liabilities. Businesses managed by the NTMA include borrowing on behalf of the Government and the management of the National Debt, the State Claims Agency, the New Economy and Recovery Authority (“NewERA”), the Ireland Strategic Investment Fund, National Development Finance Agency and the NTMA Future Ireland Funds business unit with responsibility for the management of the Future Ireland Fund and Infrastructure, Climate and Nature Fund. The NTMA also assigns staff to the Strategic Banking Corporation of Ireland (SBCI) and Home Building Finance Ireland (HBFI). **Role Summary:** **This is an exciting opportunity for talented and motivated graduates to join the ISIF division of the NTMA on a 23-month Associate Programme commencing in September 2027. The programme is open to graduates with a degree in Finance / Economics / Commerce / Accounting / Law / Science / Computer Science / Mathematics / Engineering or a related discipline** **.** **The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund (ISIF) division:** **The Ireland Strategic Investment Fund (ISIF) sources and completes investments on a commercial basis in a manner designed to support economic activity and employment in Ireland. This strategy focuses on long-term transformational investments addressing key strategic challenges facing the country. These include climate action, housing and enabling infrastructure, scaling indigenous businesses, and food and agriculture. In addition, ISIF has flexibility to invest in national and compelling investments in response to future events. See www.isif.ie for more detail. Alongside its portfolio of Irish focused investments, ISIF maintains a diversified public markets portfolio (the ISIF Funding Portfolio) which provides liquidity to fund ISIF’s ongoing commitments while contributing to ISIF’s net returns.** **Within the ISIF unit, there are three distinct functions: Investment, Portfolio Management, and Operations.** **The Associate will work in** **ISIF’s Investment function** **, (either in the Irish portfolio or the ISIF Funding Portfolio) alongside colleagues across the full range of ISIF's investment, portfolio management, and operational activities. By the end of the programme, successful candidates will have developed a strong knowledge base across all areas of the ISIF team and the investment process. This may include experience in research, due diligence, and evaluation of investment opportunities, measuring, monitoring, and managing key aspects of the portfolio, such as risk management, asset allocation, investment performance, ESG considerations, and data analytics.** **At the end of the programme the successful Associate will have developed a solid knowledge base of the ISIF unit and the wider NTMA.** **Working at the NTMA offers excellent benefits including:** * Competitive salary and 23 days annual leave * Career average defined benefit pension scheme * Education funding and paid study leave * Reimbursement of annual professional membership fees * Excellent learning and development opportunities that allow for full career development within the organisation * Extensive workplace wellbeing programme * State of the art facilities with sustainable modern workspaces * Advanced technology enabling flexible and hybrid work options * A diverse range of initiatives: LGBT+, Gender Matters, Disability Advocacy, Sports & Social, Volunteering and lots more. **Learning and Development:** Typically, Associates within this division also undertake professional examinations which are supported through the full range of NTMA study supports, complemented by a comprehensive Associate Development Programme, an Associate network spanning the NTMA, and extensive on-the-job learning opportunities. **Do you have what it takes?** Are you ambitious, commercially minded and diligent? Do you have what it takes to excel in a challenging, fast-paced team environment? Do you have the flexibility to adapt to different environments and responsibilities? Successful candidates will have a minimum of a 2.1 honours degree or a minimum of a 2.1 Masters, ideally in a related discipline. Applicants must have the correct legal status to work in Ireland (Irish Citizen, EEA Citizen, Stamp 4, Stamp 1G Visa). The NTMA are strong believers in the value a diverse work force brings to our business endeavours. We are able to accommodate candidates with a disability at every stage of our process. Should you need any additional support, please don’t hesitate to contact our Disability Liaison Officer - Laura Finnegan **Pension Abatement** If an appointee has previously been employed in the Civil or Public Service and that appointee is entitled to or in receipt of a pension from the Civil or Public Service or where a Civil/Public Service pension comes into payment during the appointee’s re-employment that pension will be subject to abatement in accordance with Section 52 of the Public Service Pensions (Single Scheme and other Provisions) Act 2012. Please note: In applying for this position, you are acknowledging that you understand that the abatement provisions, where relevant, will apply. It is not envisaged that the employing Department/Office/Body will support an application for an abatement waiver in respect of appointments to this position. Applicants will be required to complete a pre-employment declaration to confirm whether they have previously availed of a Public sector pension scheme. The NTMA is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We recognise that a diverse and inclusive workplace informs better decision making, creative thinking, innovation and drives business performance. We are strongly committed to ensuring that our workforce is representative of our society.

title: Associate Software Engineer - Agent Operations (Red Hat AI)
description: Are you ready to join a game-changing open-source AI platform that harnesses the power of hybrid cloud to drive innovation? The Agent Operations team within Red Hat AI (RHAI) is looking for a Software Engineer (New Grad) to join us in Ireland. Our team builds the infrastructure that allows AI agents to run securely and reliably on Kubernetes and OpenShift, including the OpenShell project, an open-source platform for agent orchestration, identity, and sandboxing. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, cloud-native infrastructure, and security, contributing to technology that defines how autonomous agents are deployed, governed, and trusted in production. As a new grad you will be part of a fast-paced and diverse group of engineers working worldwide to create value for our customers and partners while also being part of open source communities. You will be assigned a mentor to help you transition into your new role; they will assist you in anything you require, from engineering to personnel issues. You will pair-program with experienced engineers which will significantly help your growth as a developer. You will have free access to the acclaimed Red Hat University courses and Udemy. You will attend comprehensive training events and presentations to support your continuous growth. At Red Hat, our commitment to open source innovation extends beyond our products - it's embedded in how we work and grow. Red Hatters embrace change - especially in our fast-moving technological landscape - and have a strong growth mindset. That's why we encourage our teams to proactively, thoughtfully, and ethically use AI to simplify their workflows, cut complexity, and boost efficiency. This empowers our associates to focus on higher-impact work, creating smart, more innovative solutions that solve our customers' most pressing challenges. **What Will You Do** * Perform engineering tasks under the direction of an experienced engineer * Become an active member of an agile development team, both scrum and kanban * Learn to collaborate and innovate with other engineers in your team * Troubleshoot technical issues and help deliver creative solutions * Work both on your own, remotely, and collaboratively with others in your team * Help mentor interns or transition year students, transferring your learned skills to them * Contribute to the open-source community * Proactively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, Cursor, Claude Code) for code generation, auto-completion, and intelligent suggestions to accelerate development cycles and enhance code quality. **What Will You Bring** * Recently graduated with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical discipline * Growth mindset; willingness to learn and challenge yourself * Ability to give and receive feedback in a meaningful manner * Passion for problem-solving and debugging technical issues * Written and verbal communication skills in English * Some working knowledge/understanding of Git usage and workflows (Git workshops are provided for all new grads when they join). * A good understanding of scripting and programming with languages such Python, Golang, Rust * A basic understanding or knowledge of Linux operating systems * Some understanding of configuration management, automation tools, and containerisation technologies. * Active online presence (e.g. GitHub) with interest in community development is a plus. **About Red Hat** Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. **Inclusion at Red Hat** Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village. **Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)** Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee. Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. If you need assistance completing our online job application, email application-assistance@redhat.com. General inquiries, such as those regarding the status of a job application, will not receive a reply.

title: Associate Technical Services Engineer II
description: MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB. We are looking to speak to candidates who are interested in working out of our Dublin office under our in-office working model Monday to Friday for the first 3-6 months depending on ramping speed. Once considered ramped, they will transition to a permanent (Tuesday to Saturday) 9am-6pm work week (with 3 in-office days) to provide weekend coverage alongside other peers. Saturdays and Sundays are considered fully online workdays and not an on-call shift. Due to the 24/7 nature of our support organization, certain events throughout the year will require volunteering for coverage outside one’s normal work days or work hours (i.e. regional offsites, regional holidays, etc). These are typically announced weeks in advance with a sign-up system that considers equitability. Cool things you’ll do You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics. What you need We consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted. The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in one (or more) of the following areas * Systems administration * Distributed systems * Network Administration * Database architecture and administration * Application Architecture * Data architecture and design * Performance tuning and benchmarking * Extra bonus points if you have experience in one or more of Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, PHP, or Perl If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform). It’s crucial for every candidate that they can check off all of these boxes * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal * Genuine desire to help people * Uncontrollable urge to investigate and solve problems, with advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting skills * Ability to think on your feet, remain calm under pressure and solve problems in real-time * Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills * Strong teamwork: willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and the good judgment to know when to seek help **About MongoDB** MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer. *REQ ID: 1273390465*

Join us. **Job Description** At AECOM we have a number of exciting opportunities across the UK & Ireland for graduates to work within our Transport Planning Team. We provide advice and support to address the challenges facing society, environment and the economy. For many of our projects, we work collaboratively with colleagues across AECOM’s many disciplines, including planners, designers, architects, engineers, regeneration and environmental specialists. The majority of our projects are based in the North of England, but we also support offices across the UK and Ireland and undertake some national and international work. We are looking for an ambitious team player who wishes to assist in developing and communicating proposals for transport schemes and strategies, working in a collaborative environment. The role would suit a self-motivated individual looking to begin their career in a dynamic team helping to solve real-world, practical, challenges. We will, of course, provide you with all the training and support you need to progress your career and develop professionally. You will be working within a positive culture where learning and development is not only supported, but also actively promoted. Early work with us will typically be supporting senior staff with technical input into a variety of projects. Key responsibilities will include: * Data collection and analysis * Development of transport strategies and plans * Developing and applying transport models * Scheme development and appraisal * Preparation of transport assessments for developments * Preparation of business cases for transport schemes * Assisting in the preparation of reports, presentations, bids and proposals * Attending meetings and workshops with clients, other discipline members and stakeholders. **Qualifications** * Bachelors degree in Civil Engineering, Geography, Economics, Maths, or an MSc in Transport Planning with a 2:1 classification (or equivalent) or above * A Masters degree in Civil Engineering, Geography, Economics, Maths, or Transport Planning would be an advantage * Transport Planning modules or external clients, both verbally & in writing with the confidence to engage with a variety of people (clients, colleagues, stakeholders and sub-contractors alike) and the aptitude to rationally explain, explore and discuss technical issues and capture feedback * Enthusiastic, hard-working, with ambition and drive * Ability to structure & prioritise work effectively through close cooperation with the team as a whole * Ability to work in a team and independently without losing initiative & focus **Additional Information** * Applicants are encouraged to apply as early as possible since CVs will be reviewed, and candidates selected for an advanced offer start. * Please include a covering letter with your application and provide all predicted and/or obtained academic grades. * You must have permanent right to work in the UK as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. Working with multidisciplinary teams, you will help Jacobs and our clients achieve their sustainability objectives across environmental, social, and governance (ESG) priorities. This role is suited to engineers with sustainability experience as well as those from related disciplines such as mechanical, chemical, process, environmental, energy, building services, manufacturing, or utilities who are interested in developing their career in sustainability. You will contribute to sustainability assessments, reporting, and project delivery while building expertise in areas such as decarbonisation, energy efficiency, carbon reduction, water conservation, sustainable materials, and green building certifications. Reporting to the Sustainability Department Manager for Life Sciences in Ireland, you will collaborate with Senior Sustainability engineers across Ireland and the wider Global Sustainability team, gaining exposure to industry-leading projects, tools, and best practices while supporting innovative and sustainable outcomes for our clients. This is an exciting opportunity for engineers looking to further develop their sustainability expertise or transition into the sustainability field, while playing a meaningful role in delivering positive environmental outcomes for our clients, communities, and the broader Life Sciences sector. **Key Accountabilities Include** * Support the delivery of sustainability projects for the Ireland Life Sciences team contributing to the achievement of project sustainability objectives, goals and targets * Collaborate effectively with project team members and provide support and knowledge sharing tracking, monitoring, and reporting project sustainability metrics and prepare sustainability-related deliverables in accordance with project schedules and client requirements * Contribute to the delivery of sustainability certification processes, including LEED, BREEAM, WELL, and other relevant green building rating systems, under the guidance of senior team members where required. * Support title: Technology Financial Operations Data Analytics & BI Engineer
description: **Summary:** This role builds and supports the data models, dashboards, pipelines, and reports the Technology Financial Operations Office uses to manage technology cost, Cloud FinOps, TCO, portfolio, demand, and productivity information. The work is to move recurring reporting off manual spreadsheets and one-off files and onto governed analytics products with reliable refreshes, consistent definitions, and clear ownership. Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric are the corporate platforms for this work; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered. The test of success is whether leadership uses the reporting as delivered, without rebuilding it in a spreadsheet first and without the numbers falling apart when someone checks them. Who We Are Looking For The Technology Financial Operations Office is looking for a hands-on Data Analytics & BI Engineer to be based in Dublin. The broader team is distributed, with several senior stakeholders and complementary roles based in other offices, so this role will need to partner effectively across locations. This is a build-and-support role: the successful candidate does the BI engineering and data modeling directly, works with the stakeholders who use the output, and stays with those products once they are in production. The work runs the full path from a loosely defined reporting request through discovery, data preparation, modeling, build, validation, release, and ongoing support. It suits someone comfortable with both technical partners and non-technical business users, who can explain what a number means as readily as they can build the model behind it. The role is judged on what reaches production and gets used, not on the volume of reports produced. Why This Role Is Important to Us The Technology Financial Operations Office is moving recurring reporting off manually maintained spreadsheets and one-off files and onto BI products that can be reused across functions. Source data is fragmented across finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, and service management systems, and the questions leadership asks keep changing as the cost agenda matures. This role makes the answers reliable enough to act on without side calculations or manual reconciliation. Near-term work includes reporting for IT Total Cost of Ownership and showback, Cloud FinOps spend and optimization tracking, productivity and demand reporting, and the retirement of high-effort manual reports. These are starting points rather than the boundary of the role; the same discipline will be applied to further cost and financial analytics products as the Business Office defines them. What You Will Be Responsible For * Build and maintain data pipelines, transformations, semantic models, dashboards, and refreshable reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related analytics tools. * Modernize spreadsheet-based reporting by converting recurring, manually maintained reports into governed, reusable BI products with defined owners and a support model. * Develop reporting that supports technology financial management, IT Total Cost of Ownership, Cloud FinOps, portfolio, demand, and headcount processes, including showback views and optimization tracking. * Prepare, reconcile, and model data from finance, cloud, procurement, portfolio, headcount, and service management systems, including the transformation logic and refresh processes that keep those sources aligned. * Build reusable datasets, semantic models, and measures, together with the validation checks and exception reporting that surface data quality issues before they reach a report. * Design dashboards and reports that Business Office teams, finance partners, and senior technology leaders can read and act on without a walkthrough. * Work directly with business stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results, translating loosely defined questions into something the available data can answer. * Apply controlled release, change, and access practices so reporting stays secure, traceable, and safe to change once it is in production. * Document sources, definitions, assumptions, calculation logic, refresh schedules, and known limitations. * Support delivered products after launch, including issue intake, triage, resolution, and continuous improvement. What We Value The following skills and qualities matter most in this role: * Ownership of a vague reporting request from discovery through build, validation, release, and ongoing support, including the unglamorous parts, without needing to be chased. * Comfort working with imperfect source data, and the discipline to reconcile differences, document assumptions, and state plainly what the data will and will not support. * A clear line between actuals, forecasts, estimates, and advisory analysis, held consistently and without turning every number into a caveat. * The ability to explain a number, its limitations, and the tradeoffs behind it to a finance partner, a technical peer, or a senior executive. * Comfort working across functions where definitions, source data, and ownership are still maturing, and the patience to build alignment rather than wait for it. * A product mindset that treats reporting as a supported capability with an owner, a backlog, and a roadmap rather than a series of one-off builds. * Exacting standards for documentation, data quality, governance, and auditability, because these reports are relied on every month and are expected to hold up to review. **Education & Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Business Analytics, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered. * Hands-on experience building BI solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Fabric preferred, including Power Query, DAX, semantic models, dashboards, dataflows, lakehouse or warehouse patterns, and SQL; strong comparable enterprise BI experience will also be considered. * Demonstrated experience building data models, measures, reconciliations, and refresh processes that span multiple source systems and survive routine change in those sources. * Familiarity with financial, portfolio, procurement, cloud, and headcount data, and with IT cost transparency concepts such as Total Cost of Ownership, showback, and Cloud FinOps, preferred. * Experience documenting data lineage, definitions, calculations, and controls in a governed or regulated enterprise environment preferred. * Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to capture requirements, agree definitions, and validate results before release preferred. **Additional Requirements** This is a matrixed role. The work spans finance, FinOps, portfolio, procurement, and technology teams, with requirements that shift as the cost agenda matures and source data that rarely arrives clean. Comfort operating with that level of ambiguity, and the persistence to resolve it rather than route around it, matters as much as technical skill. Work Requirements * Full-time role based in Dublin, Ireland. * Expected to follow applicable State Street office attendance requirements for the role and location. * Standard business hours, with flexibility as needed to support stakeholders across time zones; limited travel may be required. **About State Street** Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success. We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law. title: UX/UI designer, WeTransfer

Then, we invest the proceeds into making our platform more powerful, and into acquiring new businesses. Thus, our strategy sees us combine an investor’s attention to capital allocation with the hands-on approach of an operator. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. **A few examples of your responsibilities** * **Shape high-leverage product experiences.** Design exceptional UI and UX—from early concepts to polished delivery—using the best available tools to explore more directions, move faster, and raise the quality bar. Ensure every experience is intuitive, effective, and delightful. * **Start with an LLM.** Use AI tools to clarify intent, draft short specs, and surface risks, edge cases, and initial approaches before opening any design tool. Use this work to align quickly with your team and compress the time from ambiguity to direction. * **Prototype and build with AI.** Use Cursor and Claude Code to turn rough concepts into interactive prototypes and generate production-ready frontend code. You know when to reach for code and when to reach for Figma—and you move fluidly between both to get the best result. * **Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one.** Define UX requirements early, stay in the build through QA and release, and make engineering-aware design decisions. * **Validate and measure.** Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and use what you learn to adjust direction. Track funnels, retention, and adoption to assess design effectiveness and sharpen what ships next. * **Find the highest-leverage bets from the backlog.** Identify where product improvements can unlock business value, align stakeholders around them, and move fast to deliver. **What we look for** * **Reasoning ability.** Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. * **Drive.** You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. * **Team spirit.** You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. * **Proficiency in English.** You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. **What we offer** * **Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams.** You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. * **An exceptional opportunity for growth.** We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. * **Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount.** Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience an annual salary of £85,797 in London and €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. For a candidate that we assess as possessing considerable relevant experience, the salary on offer tends to be between £112,189 and £250,512 in London, and €107,837 and €188,848 elsewhere in Europe. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact. If you're offered a permanent contract, you'll also be able to receive some of your pay in company equity at a discounted price, thus participating in the value creation we achieve together. If relocating to Italy, you may enjoy a 50% tax cut. * **All. These. Benefits.** Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. **Commitment & contract** Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. **Location** Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries. **The selection process** In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. **Before you apply** If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. title: Water Engineer
description: **The Opportunity** THE OPPORTUNITY Help solve some of Ireland's most important drinking water challenges. At Stantec, you'll work alongside experienced engineers and specialists to develop the treatment processes and infrastructure that provide safe, reliable drinking water to communities across Ireland. From upgrading existing water treatment plants to improving water quality, resilience and operational performance, you'll help shape the future of drinking water services. Whether you're developing your technical expertise, building leadership skills or working alongside some of the most respected drinking water specialists in the industry, you'll be supported to grow both professionally and personally. By joining our team, you'll help protect public health, safeguard the environment and strengthen drinking water supplies for future generations. **About The Role** As an Engineer within our Water team, you'll help clients solve some of Ireland's most complex drinking water challenges while contributing to projects that improve water quality, strengthen resilience and safeguard drinking water supplies for communities across the country. **You'll Have The Opportunity To** + Undertake and review process calculations, treatment performance assessments and optimisation studies. + Support the selection and specification of drinking water treatment technologies. + Develop practical and sustainable treatment solutions tailored to individual water sources. + Work closely with clients, contractors, suppliers and multidisciplinary project teams. + Contribute to projects from feasibility and concept development through to detailed design, construction and commissioning. From conventional processes such as coagulation, flocculation, clarification, filtration and disinfection through to supplementary solutions such as activated carbon for organics removal, you'll help develop treatment strategies tailored to the unique characteristics of each water source. One day you might be investigating colour and natural organic matter in an upland surface water source, the next optimising conditioning requirements for a groundwater supply. Understanding how raw water characteristics influence treatment performance, and applying water chemistry, process engineering and operational thinking to solve those challenges, is what makes this role both technically rewarding and genuinely engaging. You'll join a well-established and supportive team that will help you settle in, develop your expertise and build confidence. As your experience grows, you'll be given the autonomy and responsibility to take ownership of your work, while always having access to support and guidance when needed. Client engagement is a fundamental part of the role. You'll work closely with clients to understand their challenges and objectives, helping develop solutions that deliver meaningful outcomes and build the trusted relationships that underpin our success. YOUR IMPACT The work you do will help protect the future of drinking water in Ireland. Across the country, raw water sources are facing increasing challenges from climate change, changing water quality and growing demands on supply resilience. Your work will help address these challenges through sustainable treatment solutions that protect public health, support environmental stewardship and strengthen water security. At Stantec, one of our core values is We Do What Is Right . That means developing solutions that are not only technically excellent, but also environmentally responsible and focused on long-term outcomes for the communities we serve. This is more than project delivery. It's an opportunity to help safeguard one of Ireland's most valuable natural resources, protect our proud heritage of high-quality drinking water and make a lasting contribution to communities across Ireland. **About You** You're a motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex challenges and wants to make a meaningful contribution to Ireland's drinking water future. Beyond technical capability, we're looking for someone who is collaborative, curious and passionate about what they do. You enjoy working with others, bringing energy to projects and helping clients, communities and colleagues achieve the best possible outcomes. You understand that successful solutions are developed by listening to different perspectives and balancing competing priorities. Whether working with ecologists, environmental scientists, operators, planners, regulators or fellow engineers, you'll appreciate that technical excellence is only part of the answer. You're also a strong communicator, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly and adapt your approach for different audiences, from technical specialists through to clients and non-technical stakeholders. **Key Attributes And Experience Include** * Bachelor's degree in Civil, Environmental, Chemical or Process Engineering, or a related discipline. * Chartered Engineer status or working towards chartership. * Experience in drinking water treatment, water infrastructure or related water sector projects. * Knowledge of drinking water treatment technologies, water quality objectives and industry best practice. * Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. * Experience working within multidisciplinary teams and engaging with a range of stakeholders. * A passion for sustainable water solutions and protecting Ireland's water resources. **WHY JOIN US** * We put people first: We're proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed. * We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world's top 10 most sustainable companies 2025. = * We do what is right: Industry leading training and development as well as paid for professional subscriptions. A professional progression plan, supporting you to become chartered. * We are better together: A supportive and collaborative team environment to assist with the growth of your career. * Growth: We're on an exciting growth journey across the Ireland - we want you to be part of it! * Great Benefits: Competitive salary, enhanced pension plan, annual leave with the option to buy/sell additional days, private medical insurance, group income protection & life assurance included as standard! **About Stantec** Whether you’re starting out on your engineering career or are looking for a fresh challenge, Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, is a great career move. Based in Dublin, Galway, Castlebar and Cork, we are actively recruiting for team players with experience in any of the following areas – water and wastewater treatment process and network design, integrated network management, structural design, site development, road and bridge engineering, project management and administration. You’ll be working for a dynamic company with an excellent reputation in the industry. Ryan Hanley, now part of Stantec, offers a great working environment amongst friendly professionals with an emphasis on teamwork. It’s a company where your ideas and opinions will be valued and your efforts recognised and rewarded. title: Actuarial Associate
description: When you join KPMG Ireland, you are joining a community of over 4,200 employees who collectively work together, both in person and virtually, to achieve their full potential. We are known as an organisation who want you to come as you are and do work that truly matters. Joining KPMG Ireland is an opportunity to enhance your career, not only in the work that you enjoy doing, but equally through the global connections that you make, the lifelong learning that you can accomplish and the chance to make your mark. Are you our next Actuarial Associate? **Location: Dublin, as part of our hybrid working model.** **Grade: Associate** **Contract type: (Perm/FTC)** **A Snapshot Of Your Peer Group** * Hold a minimum 2.1 honours degree (or equivalent) in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, engineering, computer science, or a related field. * Relevant experience gained experience through internships, placements, university projects or early-career roles within insurance, banking, financial services, or consulting is an advantage. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex information clearly. Strong analytical, modelling, coding and automation capabilities. Curious, commercially aware and eager to learn. A team player who can integrate into small multi-disciplinary teams. **Your responsibilities and achievements will evolve as you enhance your career with us. Here is what you can initially expect:** * Support the delivery of actuarial advisory and consulting projects for insurance and financial services clients. * Perform actuarial analyses and modelling across areas such as reserving, pricing, capital, risk management and financial reporting. * Assist with actuarial reviews and transaction-related assignments, including reserve reviews, portfolio transfers and mergers and acquisitions. * Analyse data and prepare high-quality reports, presentations and client deliverables. * Work collaboratively with KPMG's multi-disciplinary teams across audit, tax, deal advisory, regulatory, risk and technology consulting. * Support clients in responding to regulatory, accounting and actuarial developments, including Solvency II, IFRS 17 and emerging industry requirements. * Contribute to the development and application of data analytics, automation and artificial intelligence solutions. * Build technical expertise, develop client relationships and actively pursue professional actuarial qualifications. **Your Team** You will be joining our actuarial team which offers a full suite of actuarial services across non-life insurance, life insurance , health insurance , and pensions **Actuarial Consulting Services Ireland** **Discover How KPMG Can Enrich Your Life Beyond Your Career** **Benefits Tailored For You** At KPMG, we understand that life is multifaceted. We also offer a variety of flexible working options to help you balance your professional and personal life. **Career Progression with Continuous Support** From the moment you join KPMG, you’ll receive dedicated support from your performance manager to enhance your skills. Our award-winning Business School provides continuous learning opportunities to deepen your expertise. We stand out as the only Big Four firm to announce promotions four times a year, offering you frequent opportunities for career advancement. **Commitment to Inclusion & Diversity** Inclusion, diversity, and equity are at the heart of KPMG. We celebrate diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable environment at every level. Our goal is to attract and retain the best talent by building a culture where everyone can achieve their potential. Learn more about our commitment here - https://kpmg.com/ie/en/home/about/inclusion-diversity-equity.html **Ready to Join Us?** If you meet most of the criteria, we encourage you to apply by submitting your CV. KPMG is an equal opportunities employer, welcoming applications from people of all backgrounds. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process if needed. Necessary arrangements can be made at interview stage to accommodate the needs of candidates with disabilities. For any specific queries about the role, please contact Carroll Daly. For a glimpse into life at KPMG, follow #ExperienceKPMG on LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and X. **Please note that agency assistance is not required for this position.** By clicking apply to this role your application will not only be considered for this position, but your details will be stored on our database and may be considered for similar future positions that may arise. This means that the personal data contained in your application and provided to KPMG as part of the application process may be retained by us for up to 18 months from the date of your application and you hereby agree to that. title: Civil & Structural Engineer
description: Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets. We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together. We are looking for highly motivated Civil & Structural Engineer to join our growing **Mobility** **Rail Civils Team** , based in our Dublin head office. This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of multidisciplinary rail and infrastructure projects, supporting the continued growth of our rail capability across Ireland and the wider region. You will be part of a collaborative and supportive working environment, with opportunities to broaden your technical experience, expand your project portfolio and progress towards professional accreditation (IEng / CEng). Flexible and hybrid working arrangements are available. As part of our continued success in work winning and project delivery, we are expanding our capacity and capability to further strengthen our industry‑leading reputation in civil and structural engineering for rail and transport infrastructure. **Job Purpose** Working under the guidance of experienced engineers and project managers, you will contribute to the delivery of civil and structural engineering design tasks across multidisciplinary rail projects. You will support the production and coordination of design outputs in line with Arcadis Business Management Systems, helping to achieve project objectives for time, quality and budget while delivering high‑quality solutions for our clients. **Key Accountabilities** * Contribute to the production of civil and structural design deliverables of varying complexity, appropriate to your experience level. * Support project delivery teams across multiple stages of the design lifecycle, including concept, design development, detailed design and construction support. * Assist with the preparation, checking and coordination of drawings, calculations, reports and other design outputs in accordance with project and quality requirements. * Work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams to coordinate design tasks, interfaces and workflows. * Support the application of innovative design approaches, digital engineering tools and the adoption of BIM‑enabled delivery. * Contribute to health & safety and safe‑by‑design principles, particularly within rail and safety‑critical environments. * Engage in continuous professional development and technical learning under the supervision of senior team members. **Qualifications & Experience** Applicants should demonstrate understanding and experience in **some or all** of the following areas: * Degree in Civil Engineering or Civil & Structural Engineering. * Awareness or experience of rail and/or transport infrastructure projects, including exposure to safety‑critical environments. * Knowledge of relevant UK and Irish railway standards, Eurocodes and associated technical guidance. * Experience or familiarity with industry‑standard structural analysis and design software. * Basic knowledge of BIM processes and experience with CAD / BIM tools, supporting BIM Level 2 delivery. * Experience supporting design activities across a range of project stages (concept, design development, detailed design and construction support). * Some experience of coordinating with other disciplines to gather information and incorporate interfaces into design outputs. * Progression through, or commitment to, a recognised professional training scheme (Engineers Ireland, ICE, IStructE or similar), with a clear ambition to achieve IEng or CEng status. **Skills & Attributes** * Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. * Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * Proactive approach to learning, development and quality. * Commitment to Arcadis values, health & safety, sustainability and ethical engineering practice. **Why Arcadis?** We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together. You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you. Together, we can create a lasting legacy. **Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.** **Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging** We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We believe that by working together diverse people with different experiences develop the most innovative ideas. Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the heart of how we improve quality of life and we work closely with our people across six ED&I Workstreams: Age, Disability, Faith, Gender, LGBT+ and Race. A diverse and skilled workforce is essential to our success.
